_comment: Versions that exist as a vX.Y.Z tag but are deliberately absent from PyPI,
each with the reason. scripts/check_published_versions.py fails on any tag
missing from PyPI that is NOT listed here, and on any entry here that IS on
PyPI (a stale exemption hides the next real gap).
Adding an entry is a decision to leave a published GitHub release
unavailable on PyPI. Prefer fixing the release over adding an entry.
0.17.0: Release published 2026-07-23, but publish.yml never ran for it: at that tag the workflow had only an `on: release` trigger and no workflow_dispatch, so there is no run to re-drive and the tag cannot be re-published without moving it.
0.18.0: publish.yml run 23 (2026-08-09) failed its own release-integrity gate: 'Missing release benchmark snapshot: benchmarks/results/history/0.18.0.json'. The tag is immutable and the file is not in its tree. release-readiness.yml exists because of this.
0.18.1: publish.yml run 26 (2026-08-11) failed the gating suite in the verify job: api-manifest drift (the environment-dependent generator bug fixed later by #869) plus a missing rank-bm25 backend in that job. Both are fixed on main; neither is fixed in the immutable v0.18.1 tree.
